## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty little girl with vibrant snap and color, featuring rosy cheeks, glossy jet-black tresses, and black eyes. Her expressive features include a merry look inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

Diana Barry is a ladylike girl who carries a merry expression. Known for her notable taste in dressing, her heart is strongly set on taking music lessons.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## History

Diana Barry was named when she was born by a schoolmaster who was boarding with her family. After meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), the two quickly became fast friends and vowed to be lifelong bosom companions. Their friendship faced a temporary disruption when Diana's mother forbade them from playing together, but they were reunited after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped nurse Diana's sister through a severe case of croup. Later, Diana helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, though she was absent from the class herself, and was the one to deliver the news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the exam pass list.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) hit it off immediately upon meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), vowing to be lifelong bosom friends and walking to school together. Their close bond faces trials when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) temporarily leaves school and when the girls are briefly separated, but their friendship is restored after Diana seeks Anne's help during Minnie May's bout with severe croup. Diana remains a supportive companion, helping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepare for major events like her recitation at [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +41 more_
